title: BSc in CSE Entry Requirements
content: Minimum GPA 2.50 in SSC and minimum GPA 2.50 in HSC separately, OR combined GPA 6.00 (with at least GPA 2.00 in either exam) subject to the minimum individual GPA condition. Applicant must be from Science background with at least a 'C' grade in Physics and Mathematics.
program_name: BSc in Computer Science and Engineering
subject_requirements: Minimum C grade in Physics and Mathematics

title: BSc in EEE Entry Requirements
content: Minimum GPA 2.50 in SSC and minimum GPA 2.50 in HSC separately, OR combined GPA 6.00 subject to minimum individual GPA condition. Science background required with minimum 'C' grade in Physics and Mathematics.
program_name: BSc in Electrical and Electronic Engineering
subject_requirements: Minimum C grade in Physics and Mathematics

title: BBA Entry Requirements
content: Minimum GPA 2.50 in SSC and minimum GPA 2.50 in HSC separately, OR combined GPA 6.00 subject to minimum individual GPA condition. Students from any academic group (Science, Business Studies, Humanities) may apply.

title: BSc in Fashion Design and Technology Entry Requirements
content: Minimum GPA 2.00 in both SSC and HSC (or equivalent). Students from any academic group may apply subject to department policy.
program_name: BSc in Fashion Design and Technology

title: BA (Hons) in English Entry Requirements
content: Minimum GPA 2.50 in SSC and minimum GPA 2.50 in HSC separately, OR combined GPA 6.00 subject to minimum individual GPA condition. Any academic group may apply.

title: LLB (Hons) Entry Requirements
content: Minimum GPA 2.50 in SSC and minimum GPA 2.50 in HSC separately, OR combined GPA 6.00 subject to minimum individual GPA condition. Any academic group may apply.

title: Other Undergraduate Programs (Civil, Textile, Mathematics, Bangla, Islamic Studies)
content: Engineering programs (Civil Engineering, Textile Engineering) and Mathematics generally require Science background and standard UGC/university GPA thresholds (typically 2.50 in SSC & HSC separately or 6.00 combined, with relevant science subjects). Exact current subject/GPA minimums for Civil, Textile, Mathematics, Bangla, and Islamic Studies must be confirmed on the official Entry Requirements page.
program_name: BSc in Civil Engineering / BSc in Textile Engineering / BSc (Hons) in Mathematics / BA (Hons) in Bangla / BA (Hons) in Islamic Studies
subject_requirements: Verify specific departmental criteria on Entry Requirements page

title: English Medium (O-Level & A-Level) Entry Requirements
content: For GCE / English Medium applicants: O-Level in at least 5 subjects with minimum average grade point 2.50, and A-Level in at least 2 subjects with minimum average grade point 2.00 (only one 'E' grade is acceptable; scale A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=1). Science/engineering programs also require relevant Mathematics/Physics subjects.

title: Diploma Holder Admission Requirements
content: Diploma-in-Engineering or equivalent BTEB diploma holders are eligible to apply for relevant undergraduate engineering and degree tracks (such as CSE, EEE, Civil, Textile, or Fashion Design) with SSC minimum GPA requirements and a recognized Diploma CGPA. Possible credit exemptions/waivers depend on departmental evaluation and evening/diploma program policy.

title: International / Foreign Student Admission
content: Foreign / international applicants must hold academic qualifications equivalent to Bangladesh SSC and HSC (12 years of schooling for undergraduate) or an accredited Bachelor's degree (for Master's), along with valid passport, academic transcript equivalence, and student visa clearance via the Admission Office.
